name: Punctured-Cube Root Repair
definition: Let $X=\{1,2,3,4\}$ and $\mathcal K=2^X\setminus\{\{1\}\}$. Consider the candidate root $R=\{2\}$.
properties: The unique rooted-union hole at $R$ is $\{1\}$: after reflection it is $\{1,2\}$, the union of two present singletons. Every neighbor of the hole is present, so contraction of any coordinate makes the projected $R$ a valid root. The punctured-subcube conclusion recovers all fifteen states from the four neighbors.
